title: Electromagnetic Optics, Guided-Wave, and Fiber Optics
description: Polarization optics: crystal optics, birefringence. Guided-wave optics: modes, losses, dispersion, coupling, switching. Fiber optics: step and graded index, single and multimode operation, attenuation, dispersion, fiber optic communications. Resonator optics. Program or materials fees may apply. Prerequisites: ECE 107 with grades of C– or better.
